elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 applies to “each Party” and expressly states that the cap is mutual.

elements.element: The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Although the cap is the greater of a 12-month payment measure and USD 1,000,000, the period precedes the “event giving rise to the claim,” not the claim itself, and the base is all amounts under the Agreement and Order Forms rather than fees.

elements.element: The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: No exclusion of indirect or consequential damages appears in the rendered language or supplied defined terms.

elements.element: Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Breach of confidentiality is an Excluded Claim, and Section 21.1 applies the cap only “Except for Excluded Claims.”

elements.element: Breach of data protection and security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Breaches of data-protection and security obligations are Excluded Claims and therefore outside the cap.
Indemnification obligations are Excluded Claims and therefore outside the cap.
Gross negligence is an Excluded Claim and therefore outside the cap.
Wilful misconduct is an Excluded Claim and therefore outside the cap.
Fraud is an Excluded Claim and therefore outside the cap.

elements.element: Infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Infringement or misappropriation of the other Party’s intellectual property is an Excluded Claim and therefore outside the cap.

elements.element: Customer payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.
elements.evidence: The exclusion covers only undisputed “Fees” for conforming Services; “Fees” is narrowly defined as the USD 12,000 Implementation Fee, so other Customer payment obligations are not excluded.

elements.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 applies to “each Party” and expressly states that the cap is mutual.

elements.element: The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
elements.evidence: Section 21.1 uses all amounts paid or payable under the Agreement and Order Forms during a twelve-month period, satisfying the fallback’s general 12-month payment-base requirement.
Indemnification obligations are Excluded Claims and therefore outside the cap.
